title: Demons
definition: Demons are evil spiritual beings who follow Satan in rebellion against God and seek to deceive, oppress, and oppose God's purposes.
summary: Demons are real but defeated spiritual enemies under God's ultimate authority.
christFocus: Jesus has authority over demons and triumphs over the powers of evil.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Demons are real spiritual beings opposed to God. Scripture shows their deception, fear of Christ, opposition to truth, and involvement in spiritual conflict.

Demons are not all-powerful, all-knowing, or sovereign. They are creatures under God's ultimate authority, and they tremble before the Lord.

Jesus demonstrated complete authority over demons. Through His victory, believers need not live in terror. They must be watchful, prayerful, and grounded in Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People can fall into denial, superstition, or fear when thinking about demons. Demons matter because Scripture gives a serious but not panic-driven view.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not become fascinated with darkness. Stand firm in Christ, reject false teaching, pray, stay grounded in Scripture, and remember that the One in believers is greater than the one in the world.

relatedTopics: God's Protection and Christ's Victory Over Evil
